DT_ItemDescriptionText.ITEM_DESC_Palvolve_EvolutionStone: A mysterious stone humming with life energy. Unshaped and inert on its own - prime it with an elemental essence at the Pal Alchemy Workbench to forge the Primed Evolution Stone an evolution demands.
DT_ItemDescriptionText.ITEM_DESC_Palvolve_AdaptionStone: A shimmering stone attuned to elemental forces. Required for evolutions into forms attuned to this element; adaptations themselves need no stone, only the right conditions.
DT_ItemDescriptionText.ITEM_DESC_Palvolve_Essence_Normal: Concentrated neutral energy, extracted from skill fruits or elemental materials. Used to craft the matching Primed Evolution Stone.
